about_the_game:
In Embassy Says No, you play the role of an immigration officer working at your country's embassy. Your job is to interview visa applicants and decide who gets approved and who doesn't. Some will meet the criteria perfectly. Others might try to deceive you.

Just because an applicant has the right documents doesn’t mean they’re telling the truth. Pay close attention to details like birth dates, employment history, or travel plans to uncover inconsistencies. It's up to you to ask the right questions.

Each applicant is powered by AI, allowing for dynamic, open-ended interviews. You’re free to interrogate them however you choose; just be prepared for unexpected answers.

Policies will shift, new visa types will be introduced, and the pressure will increase. Stay sharp, follow the rules, and don’t let a liar slip through!

Key features

  • AI-driven interviews: Find the liars by interviewing them thoroughly. Ask the right questions to get your answers. 

  • Every day, something new: As you advance in the game, the more reasons to decline an applicant appear. Learn to master each to progress further.

  • Customize your country: Want to play good old England or your own fantasy country? Set your flag or upload your own to make the embassy your own.

Wishlist Embassy Says No now to stay up to date!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or comparable Intel processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game runs a local LLM that requires a lot of processing power. Requirements may change.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or comparable Intel processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 SUPER
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game runs a local LLM that requires a lot of processing power. Requirements may change.

short_description: Decide who can get a visa for your country and who gets turned away. Question each applicant and spot inconsistencies to catch liars. Use AI-driven interviews where responses change based on what you ask. Will you uphold the rules or bend them?
supported_languages:
English*, French*, German*, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil*, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian
*languages with full audio support
